items.title: 2026-020: Critical Vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway

items.title: Authentication bypass in Payara Server administration REST interface
items.summary: Payara Server administration REST interfaces are affected by an authentication bypass that can let an unauthenticated remote attacker run administrative commands. Exposure requires the administration interface to be reachable and is described as exploitable on default domains using an empty administrative password.
items.mitigation: Upgrade Payara Server to 7.6.0, 7.2026.11, 6.44.0, 5.93.0, or 4.1.2.191.61, as appropriate for your release line. Set a non-empty administrative password and restrict remote access to the administration interface.

items.title: Server-side request forgery in JeecgBoot OpenApiController
items.summary: JeecgBoot 3.9.5 and earlier contain a server-side request forgery issue in the /openapi/call handler. A remote attacker without authentication may cause the server to make requests; the affected endpoint must be reachable to the attacker.
items.mitigation: Restrict or block untrusted access to /openapi/call, such as at a reverse proxy or network boundary. Upgrade to a vendor release newer than 3.9.5 after confirming it contains a fix; the evidence does not name a fixed ve…

items.title: Unauthenticated API key disclosure in MISP Modules external tools
items.summary: The MISP Modules website external-tools interface can disclose stored API keys through an unauthenticated endpoint and its edit interface. items.mitigation: Restrict network access to the MISP Modules website and its external-tools endpoints to trusted users and networks. Rotate API keys configured for external tools, especially if the service may have been exposed; no fixe…
